about: The golden cases in data/quality/golden_cases_held_out/ (data/eval/golden_cases_held_out/ until the folders were regrouped on 2026-10-24; the cases unchanged), set aside on 2026-10-13 to measure whether tuning on the development cases (data/quality/golden_cases/) carries over. Never edited to fit the app, never tuned on, run only with python -m quality.golden_cases --held-out when the owner asks. sha256 is quality/golden_cases.py content_hash: the hash of the file's JSON content, so line endings and layout don't change it. quality/tests/test_golden_cases.py fails if a case differs from its hash, and --held-out then runs nothing. A change the owner decides on (e.g. after the team reviews a case) gets its new sha256, frozen_on and a note saying why.
